title: Hellhatch, turns out pixel art is harder than I thought
author: Lazy_Assistance_1137
selftext:
I've been working on Hellhatch, an isometric dungeon crawler, and posting regular dev updates on YouTube. Figured I'd share the latest one here too.

I've been using Claude and ChatGPT for development and PixelLab for the characters. I honestly underestimated how difficult it would be to get the pixel art style right. It's been a lot more work than I expected.

There's a Kickstarter page already, but unfortunately no Steam page yet. The Steam registration process is taking forever and I really should've started that much earlier. Oh well, you live and learn.

Anyway, here's the latest update. Curious what you think of the visuals so far.
